strategies.name: Test fabs simplification with sqrt and nsz
strategies.rationale: The patch changes fabs simplification from SignBitMustBeZero to computeKnownFPSignBit. With nsz flag, sqrt(-0.0) = -0.0 but sign bit should be considered 0. The new code might be more conservative.
strategies.expected_issue: fabs(sqrt(x)) might not simplify to sqrt(x) when it should with nsz flag.

strategies.name: Test maxnum/minnum with zero operands
strategies.rationale: The patch adds sign bit inference for min/max intrinsics. The logic for handling zeros is complex and might incorrectly infer sign bit for maxnum(+0.0, x) or minnum(-0.0, x).
strategies.expected_issue: Incorrect sign bit inference for min/max operations with zero operands.

strategies.name: Test knownNot method sign bit inference
strategies.rationale: The patch adds sign bit inference in knownNot when NaN is never and sign bit is unknown. This might incorrectly infer sign bit in edge cases.
strategies.expected_issue: Incorrect sign bit inference when ruling out negative or positive classes.

strategies.name: Test FMul sign bit inference
strategies.rationale: The patch adds sign bit inference for FMul when both operands have known sign bits. This might not handle NaN correctly.
strategies.expected_issue: Incorrect sign bit inference for multiplication with NaN operands.

strategies.name: Test copysign optimization
strategies.rationale: The patch changes copysign optimization from SignBitMustBeZero to computeKnownFPSignBit. The new code returns std::optional<bool> which might be more conservative.
strategies.expected_issue: copysign might not optimize when it should.
